character_types: man in beanie drinking in the park
visual_synopsis: In a leaf-covered autumn park a bearded man dressed as a medieval Armenian monk-scribe, in a tall pointed hood, reads aloud from a manuscript sheet and holds up a hand-lettered sign, gesturing with a raised fist. The whole sketch is a shot/reverse-shot conversation between him and a man in an olive beanie and tan coat who wanders in, swigs from a glass bottle and argues back among the bare trees.
